title: Khalifah of Sayyidina al-Mahdi Alayhissalam
body:
As-salam `alaykum. As-salam `alayka ya Shaykh Hisham Effendi, Masha’Allah min khulafa Sayyidina alMahdi, `alayhi's-salaam.
I am from good manners, an natawwajah al-majlis, arabce soyliyor?
(Arabic) It is good manners that we must look who may be authority to speak to address people. I am looking
Shaykh Hisham, he has that authority from our Grandshaykh, as well as he is authorized through the Seal of
Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). Ya Sayyidi, ya Rasulullah, madad. Anytime you may give your will in the
hands (of) such an authorized people, then you are not going to carry responsibility. Therefore, I am a little
bit clever one, making my heavy burden on Shaykh Hisham, asking, “Please address people” and he is saying,
“no, you can do this.” If I can do this, whole responsibility, (whole) wrong from me, he is carrying and it is
enough for a young one to carry.
I am old one. I am thinking to buy an old donkey. What is your opinion, O people? Like me, old one, to ride
on it and to go up and down through this village’s roads and I may look what should be reception from
people. People going to be happy or swearing to me, doesn’t matter! I am saying that swearing for my donkey,
not for me. Therefore, if any one swearing to you and angry with you, you may say, “I am not responsible, but

my donkey responsible (for) making something wrong!” and then swearing my donkey, and I am not saying
who. What is the name of your donkey? My donkey’s name, O Shaykh, is “e?ek.” I know a Shaykh…US.
There is a big country, they are saying US. I learned first in elementary school, O Shaykh, as a little one was
written first page “I” and in front of it a donkey’s picture, but written under it “ass”. Therefore, I learned first
from English language, “I ass.” It is true. Therefore, beware, O people, that if anyone swearing to you say, “I
don’t mind because that one, that ass one, is swearing on my ass also. That is also ass and swearing to my ass.
Doesn’t matter, don’t be angry!” (Laughter)
There was our brother coming and selling something, everywhere he was going and asking to be known that
he is bringing something for selling, also he was imitating a donkey and loudly like donkey shouting, and
people saying, “Our donkey calling,” and running to him. It is a good adab that we are saying that you must
be able to make a difference between yourself and your donkey. You are always a two one, firstly you are a
donkey and second you are a man. If we are speaking from a real position, our egos, means your ego is your
ride. To ride on it and to try to find your way to Heavens.
Prophet (s) was first just brought to him Buraq ash-Shareef, holy horse from Paradise, and riding on it from
Holy Mecca to Holy Quds ash-Shareef, Masjid al-Aqsa in Jerusalem. And he (s) was asking, “Is my nation
given what I have been given?” and Heavenly answer coming, “Yes, We gave to them also a ride. If they are
riding, they may be able to ride on it, they should be able to reach what you are able to be there.” And that is a
signing that Allah Almighty created donkeys to be a ride for mankind and it is slowly, slowly walking but
sometimes some people whom their levels is level of donkeys getting angry and trying to kick him and strike
him. It is not true. And, O our listeners through east and west, I am also one servant of our Lord Almighty
and everyone they have been created to be servants of heavenly service for the Lord of Heavens. All of us just
granted a ride, and our ride is our donkeys, that is ego. Ego. We have been ordered to train or to teach our
donkeys good manners, good manners. Good manners making people to reach to their real positions or
stations through Heavens because Allah Almighty just appointed for everyone a station through Heavens.
And He is ordering, “O My servants, ride on your rides and coming to Me! I am inviting you to be in My
Divinely Presence.”
Therefore, we are in need adab, good manners. You must learn good manners, training our rides and whole

religions, that they are Heavenly messages just had been sent to messengers on Earth, all of them from
beginning up to end, they are good manners. Teaching good manners to people. But now people they are
leaving to learn good manners but they are trying to follow their silly rides’ demands. People now trying to
fulfill demands of their silly rides and so that 99% people, they are trying to make their silly rides happy, not
thinking to make their Lord’s happiness. They are not trying to make, to find pleasement of their Lord; 99%
people on Earth, if you are making a … sometimes government asking to their people, “Are you happy with
voting for this referendum?” He is making a referendum. Everyone saying, ohhh, I must try to make my ride
happy, no one else. Therefore, it was mentioned through Holy words of the Seal of Prophets (s), say that the
partnership is so sacred through my nation, even you can hear ants walking, but that egoistic partnership is
so hidden. It is so mushkil, harm to know it.
And now people, there is a group of people, if you are saying “ya Rasulullah,” they are saying that is shirk.
Those people no mind people. If sometimes such a people, if you are visiting Holy Prophet’s Holy place and
making your hand on window, they saying you make shirk. And I am saying, you are partner to Allah? How
you are saying this, for what? Who gave to you ahkamu ’l-haakimeen (the Highest Judge) to give last
judgment on your Lord? How you are saying, no you are making shirk? What is your proof? No proof! And
they are just falling into darkness of real shirk. May Allah forgive us.
People running only to make their egos happy. Happy to make their egos please. Yes. You may do for
sometimes your ego pleased, but day-by-day you are getting older. Don’t think that you are going to be like a
car, coming out from gallery zero kilometers. People thinking that they should continue to be zero kilometers.
No! Zero kilometers day-by-day getting older, older, older and they are going to be like myself. And you are
going to be like old donkey, old donkey, not young. They are not looking to themselves, they are finishing,
finishing. Leave Last Judgment to the Lord of Heavens, Allahu subhanahu wa ta’ala. Allahu Akbar al-Akbar.
Holy Qur`an says, O Shaykh, don’t say who…
••••• •••••••••• •••••• ••••••• •••••••••• •••••••••• •••••• •••••••••
O ye who believe! When ye go abroad in the cause of Allah, investigate carefully, and say not to any one who
offers you a salutation: "Thou art none of a believer!" 4:94

Even if saying As-salamu alaykum, don’t say that the person for his other works, that he is going out of Islam,
no. To say As-salaam alaykum, it is a proof that he is Muslim. Then how they understanding, those Arab
people, to accuse people with partnership or saying you are not Muslim, if you are saying As-salaatu wa
salamu alayka ya Rasulullah!, saying you are making shirk, what is this? No mind people, no mind people.
And I am going to be cursing against them on Yawm al-Qiyama. I am sending against whole Wahhabi people
that those people, O my Lord, they were preventing to be said for Your Most Glorious, Most Honored, Most
Beloved Servant!
If you are saying As-salatu wa salamu alayka ya Rasulullah!, I am standing in Divinely Presence and calling
all those Wahhabi people, saying I am against those people that are preventing and You are giving salat wa
salam, salutations continuously.
Inna Allaha wa mala`ikatuhu yusaloona `ala an-nabiyy. (Surat al-Ahzab 33:56)
How they are understanding? Allah Almighty without stopping, always giving His Divinely respect and
dressing more glory on Habeebullah, on Rasulullah (s), and they are saying if you say As-salatu wa salamu
alayka ya Rasulullah!, you are mushrik, you are kafir? A`udhu billah, A`udhu billah! I am asking from the
Lord of Heavens to make their last days no good, to be in trouble and people runs away from them. Only
remains with them Shaytan and Shaytan’s helpers. Na`udhu billah.
O people! You are Muslims and we must learn some important points in Islam, to keep them, not to follow
such a foolish people, misunderstanding people, no, no! I don’t think that after Prophet’s leaving this life for
Eternity, I don’t know any Sahaba coming in front of his Holy tomb and not saying As-salatu wa salamu
alayka ya Rasulullah! They are believers because Prophets have real life, even through their tombs, and they
are answering. No any Sahaba, Companions without hearing, never standing in front of Prophet’s holy tomb
and saying As-salaatu wa salaamu alayka. (They are) saying (to Prophet) and hearing (his reply). O people! If
someone giving to you salaam, salutation, give answer, it is better. Therefore, and we are believing that
prophets are living ones, even through their tombs, and if anyone saying As-salaat wa salaamu alayka, ya
Sayyidi, ya Rasulullah!, the Companions were looking and seeing Rasulullah (s) and hearing perfectly his
reply, Wa alaykum as-salaam ya sahibee.
O Muslims! Correct your beliefs. Try to be real believers in prophecy and you must try to give your high

respect and to ask glory from Allah Almighty to His most glorified and most honored, most beloved Sayyidina
Muhammad (s). May Allah forgive us.
O people! Hear and listen and obey. If not, there is Heavenly whip should strike them and whole Islamic
world now they are just broken, they are left, Allah Almighty saying come all together and they are saying no,
we may be everyone separated. And Allah saying be all of you one hand, but our Muslims saying no, everyone
must be alone through himself or herself.
O people! Astaghfirullah bikum. Ask your Lord’s forgiveness. If He is not forgiving us, our future is not good
because forgiveness carrying blessings. If no blessing, nothing coming from Heavens. O people! Ask
forgiveness so that you should reach Heavenly Mercy Oceans, Heavenly blessings of Allah Almighty.
I think it is enough. They may give me to speak, to address you up to next week never ending, next month
never ending, and next year never ending, up to end of the world, speaking for the honor of that most
honored one, never finishing. If Allah giving, giving endlessly. Ask from His endless Mercy Oceans for you
and for those people whom they are obeying Heavenly Orders, and trying to reach pleasement for their Lord
Almighty. That is last goal through our lives to reach, to make our Lord pleased with us and happy with us, to
be beloved ones in His Divinely Presence.
O people! Time is over. Running, time running, running so quickly and we are approaching on Last Day,
Yawm al-Qiyamah approaching. Take care for yourself because this material being is not going to be with you
up to Eternity, no! Your car getting older and one day going to stop, then they are throwing it automobile
qabaristan, cemetery of cars. Our cars getting older then taking people, put that one…. open the doors coming
another old car… oohh don’t say car it was a truck. He was not small car, he was truck. Doesn’t matter, take
by foot throw him away. Ha ha! So many people thinking they are trucks, trucks. You and your truck, through
cemetery of cars! What we shall do?
Don’t try to buy cars or you may carry on your shoulders to cemetery and you are crying, O my car, O my
truck, O my…? Which kind car, ehh it was Mercedes and now you are throwing car in cemetery, what we shall
do? It became now old Mercedes, no my car is now... (inaudible). Another? UMP? UWP? BMW that once
upon a time was running to MWC. What is the name? BMWC, really. Now… Therefore, I am not taking such a

cars, my driver Ali Hussein that his mind from his head two meters up, he was carrying me behind car, goats
and sheep, and he was sitting right hand of me making me to sit in front also on that….? If we are throwing
that car anywhere, we are not crying, we are saying alhamdulillah. But WC car, BMW. You have such a…?
When I was a small one, there was only ….? Italian. There was Chevrolet, French one or English one, no any
other car! Now you can’t count the names of cars. Ehhh, you and your car you must think that you are going
to be thrown, your old body thrown through cemetery and your car to car cemetery.
Don’t be cheated such a things. Ask reality, ask your real mission on earth and give your endless glory and
respects just glorified and honored, no one honored like himself, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). Allahumma salli
`ala Sayyidina Muhammadin nabi’ul umiyy wa` ala alihi wa sahbihi wa sallam…
[Shaykh Hisham: There are two who want baya` Sayyidee.]
Give them baya`, give them tariqah.
[Shaykh Hisham: ashadu an la ilaha ill-Allah wa ashadu anna muhammadan abduhu wa rasuluh.Inna
alladheena yuba`yoonaka innamaa yuba`yoon’Allah. Yadullahi fawqa aydeehim. Faman nakatha fa-innamaa
yankuthu `ala nafsihi wa man awfa bimaa `ahad `alayhillah fa sayu`teehi ajran `azheema. Radayna billahi
rabban wa bi’l-Islami deenan wa bi Sayyidina Muhammadin nabiyyan wa rasoola wa bi’l-Qurani kitaban
w’Allahu `ala maa naqoolu wakeel. Wa qabilna bi mawlana Shaykh Muhammad Nazim shaykhan wa
murshidan. Allahu Allahu Allahu haqq. Allahu Allahu Allahu haqq. Allahu Allahu Allahu haqq. Ila sharafi’nNabi... Shaykh Abdullah al-Faiz ad-Daghestani wa sayyidee Shaykh Muhammad Nazim al-Haqqani]
Fatiha!
